description: In every PA-model, the specified primitive-recursive program with equations \(d(0)=0\) and \(d(Sn)=S(S(d(n)))\) has value \(n+n\) at every internal input \(n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PAComputations.doubling_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (n y : M) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.PAComputations.doubling.graph.Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend ![n] y) ↔
    y = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M n n
